tasks.answer: Use the shared ConfirmationDialog: required triggerButton and confirmButton (React elements) plus title (string); body, icon, cancelButtonText and isDone are optional. Note the discussions module already wraps this for deletion in discussions.DeleteDiscussion (single required prop: id), which is what discussions-list.tsx renders.

The login form uses the shared Input. It binds to react-hook-form through the required registration prop: pass the result of register('email')/register('password') (UseFormRegisterReturn); label/error are optional and rendered via FieldWrapper, so it must live inside Form.

The discussions list pages with TablePagination (tasks: table-pagination/pagination). It requires totalPages, currentPage and rootUrl and builds links as rootUrl?page=N, so rootUrl must not already contain a query string; Table renders it when its pagination prop is supplied.
MDPreview renders Markdown as sanitized HTML with prose typography; its single required input prop is value (the raw Markdown string), sanitized with DOMPurify.
CreateDiscussion is the admin-only drawer form that creates a discussion with a title and Markdown body. It requires the Authorization provider: only admins see the trigger; it takes no props.

notes: All answers derived from catalog search/get only; no project source files were read (catalog documented props, import paths, constraints and production examples). Task 1 is the one ambiguous item: the generic primitive is ui.dialog.confirmation-dialog.ConfirmationDialog, while the discussions feature already ships discussions.DeleteDiscussion (required prop id: string) for the same delete-confirmation.
